text:
Aisha: Heads up - a new hire couldn't finish the quickstart; our CLI docs say RW_API_KEY but the JavaScript sample uses REDWOOD_API_KEY. They hit a 401 and filed a support ticket.
Tom: That's bad. We should pick one canonical env var and implement fallbacks in SDKs.
Priya: Proposal: lookup order RW_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY -> ~/.redwood/credentials -> metadata. SDKs should return (key, source) and not raise KeyError.
Aisha: Also support REDWOOD_KEY_ID header for rotation so ops can stage keys.
Tom: Add a clear diagnostic when not found: "no API key found; tried RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY" plus a docs link.
Priya: I'll add a small helper in py/js/go and a CI quickstart test that runs with each var set.
InfraBot: Ticket DE-4470 created: "env var parity + runtime rotation support" assigned to @Priya.
Aisha: Temp workaround for support: export RW_API_KEY=<key>.
Tom: Also log non-identifying telemetry when fallback used (opt-out via RW_TELEMETRY=0).
Priya: Sounds good — I'll draft PRs for SDKs and update the sample app README.
